full_prompt_en: A square retro superhero poster illustration layers two large helmeted faces above much smaller standing figures against a cream, faded blue, and rust-red background. In the upper left, the largest face turns in profile toward the left. A bold blue mask encloses a golden eye beneath a red-and-yellow swept helmet, whose pointed shapes extend across the top and toward the center. The lower part of this face is warm cream and orange, with a firm nose, straight mouth, and sharp jaw. On the right, a second helmeted face looks upward and slightly right, wearing a rounded blue eye frame and red-white headgear. The two portraits overlap rather than occupying separate panels, creating a layered composition of different viewpoints. Near the lower center, a small dark-haired person in a blue outfit stands in three-quarter view. Another even smaller figure appears to the left, and a simple aircraft silhouette crosses the pale area nearby. Faint structural shapes and vertical scuffs fill the lower background, but they remain subordinate to the expressive masked faces. Light is represented through broad warm cream and orange planes on the cheeks and helmets, with cool blue shadows under the headgear. The paint appears printed on aged paper: fine grain, worn pigment, scratches, and slightly misregistered color edges soften the bold geometry. The palette stays limited to faded teal-blue, burnt red, ocher yellow, and cream, with deep navy for the strongest outlines. There is no readable text. The overall composition is heroic and nostalgic, using asymmetrical scale, overlapping faces, and distressed color to suggest a larger adventure beyond the frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古超级英雄海报插画把两张巨大的戴头盔面孔层叠在更小的站立人物上方，背景由奶油色、褪色蓝和锈红组成。左上最大的面孔朝左呈侧脸。一副醒目的蓝色面罩围住金色眼睛，外面是红黄相间、向后扫起的头盔，尖角形状穿过画面顶部伸向中央。脸的下半部为暖奶油和橙色，有坚定的鼻子、平直的嘴和锐利下颌。右侧第二张戴头盔的脸望向右上，带圆形蓝色眼罩和红白头具。两张大像互相重叠，而非处在独立格子里，形成不同视点层叠的构图。靠下中央，一名深发小人物穿蓝衣，以四分之三角度站立。更小的人物在左侧出现，附近还有一架简单飞机剪影穿过浅色区域。微弱的结构形状和竖向磨痕填充下方背景，但仍从属于富有表情的蒙面面孔。光通过脸颊和头盔上的宽阔暖奶油、橙色色面表现，头具下方有冷蓝阴影。颜料像印在老纸上：细颗粒、磨损色料、刮痕和略微错位的颜色边缘柔化大胆几何。配色限制在褪色青蓝、焦红、赭黄和奶油色，最强轮廓用深海军蓝。没有可读文字。整体构图英雄化且怀旧，以不对称尺度、重叠面孔与磨旧色彩暗示画框以外更大的冒险。
style_prompt_en: The retro poster illustration uses oversized overlapping silhouettes, limited faded colors, and visibly worn print texture. Broad warm cream and burnt red planes oppose teal-blue shadows, while yellow accents sharpen selected directional forms. A few very large shapes command the top of the composition; much smaller marks near the bottom establish narrative scale without competing for attention. Graphic contours stay crisp enough to read at a glance, but scratches, grain, and imperfect color edges keep the surface tactile. Light is encoded as flat neighboring value areas rather than soft realistic modeling. Diagonals and pointed shapes move through a mostly pale field, with cool dark blocks providing weight. The overall effect is adventurous, bold, and nostalgic, combining energetic scale changes with aged ink-like finish.
style_prompt_zh: 这种复古海报插画使用过大的重叠剪影、有限的褪色颜色和可见磨旧印刷肌理。宽阔暖奶油与焦红色面对照青蓝阴影，黄色重音使选中的定向形状更锐利。少数极大形体统领构图上方，下方小得多的痕迹建立叙事尺度，却不争夺注意。图形轮廓足够清晰，一眼可读，但刮痕、颗粒与不完美颜色边缘让表面可触。光以相邻的平坦明度区域编码，而非柔和写实塑形。斜线和尖角形穿过以浅色为主的底场，冷调深色块提供重量。整体效果冒险、醒目且怀旧，把充满能量的尺度变化与老化墨色完成度结合。
theme_en: Layered masked hero profiles above smaller figures in a retro poster
theme_zh: 复古海报中层叠的蒙面英雄侧脸与下方小人物
name: Gatchaman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
